Android app for the Ninebot MAX G3. Install `g3-connect.apk` on Android 8 or newer.

**Uninstall any older version first** (G3 Connect Beta or G3 Maps Bridge). 1.0 has a new signature, so it cannot be installed as an update. Pair the scooter again afterwards.

## New in 1.0

- **Custom sounds:** upload an audio file or a test tone for the custom button (slot 71), alarm (72), power on (73) or a slot of your choice. Switch each event between custom sound and built-in tone.
- **Custom button:** assign any of the eight actions. An upload for the button sets it to "play custom sound" automatically, and the previous action can be restored.
- **Play all sounds:** play the sound numbers one after another to hear what the scooter has.
- No more "Beta" in the name. New short README.

## Still included

- Google Maps navigation on the scooter display, manual sending, display test
- Sport acceleration level 1–3 and range display, every value read back
- Log and Maps diagnostic

Tested against a simulated scooter. The power-on sound is confirmed on a real MAX G3. The custom button and the alarm slot are not confirmed on a scooter with this app yet.

Setup: [android-bridge/README.md](https://github.com/xuynix1337/g3-connect/blob/main/android-bridge/README.md). SHA-256 of the APK: see `g3-connect.sha256`.
